sections.title: Cases needing attention
sections.sql: select * from v_attention order by due,code,finding

sections.title: Decision queue
sections.sql: select code,owner,due_on,decision_state,evidence_gaps from v_casework where status='open' order by due_on

sections.title: Requirements and evidence currency
sections.sql: select code,name,policy_reference,due_on,finding,checked_on,expires_on from v_evidence order by code,name

sections.title: Next 30 days
sections.sql: select code,owner,recertify_on,decision_state from v_casework where status='open' and recertify_on<=current_date+30 order by recertify_on

sections.title: Open appeals
sections.sql: select a.code,p.owner,p.due_on,p.reason from appeals p join applications a on a.id=p.application_id where p.status='open' order by p.due_on
